published_results.claim: In a blind test, judges preferred Humanizer's rewrite over the original AI text 16 times out of 16 ([#229](https://github.com/blader/humanizer/issues/229)).
published_results.metric: blind pairwise human preference (rewrite vs original AI text)
published_results.notes: Only supporting material is the project's own GitHub issue https://github.com/blader/humanizer/issues/229 (not in the clone, not verifiable offline). No judge protocol, sample texts, or judge identities committed. Not an independent third-party evaluation.

summary: The only quantitative result is a single README line claiming judges preferred the rewrite 16 of 16 times in a blind test, backed only by a link to the project's own GitHub issue #229; no test texts, protocol, or harness exist in the repo (scripts/validate-package.py only lints package files). The README explicitly disclaims AI-detector evasion and states detectors still flag most output, without giving a number.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
